extracted.intended_audience: school districts, professional associations, legislative staff, education service centers, and members of the public interested in TEA commissioner rulemaking
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance from the Texas Education Agency describing how commissioner rules are published, how the public is notified, and how stakeholders may submit comments or request public hearings on proposed commissioner rules. Includes contact information and timing requirements for comment and hearing requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Posting of proposed commissioner rules
rubrics_metrics.description: TEA posts proposed commissioner rules on the Commissioner of Education Rules - Texas Administrative Code (TAC) website prior to publication in the Texas Register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site contains an item describing the proposed rule action, the statutory authority for the rule action, and the proposed rule text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Posting of adopted but not yet effective rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules that the commissioner has adopted but that are not yet effective are also posted on the Commissioner of Education Rules - Texas Administrative Code website.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of currently effective commissioner rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Commissioner rules that are currently effective are available at the Texas Administrative Code webpage as part of the Texas Administrative Code, Title 19, Part II.

rubrics_metrics.name: Email notifications to 'Rules' mailing list
rubrics_metrics.description: The TEA Rulemaking Unit sends email notifications of proposed and adopted commissioner rules to members of the 'Rules' mailing list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notifications include a link to the Commissioner of Education Rules - Texas Administrative Code website. The 'Rules' mailing list includes school districts, professional associations, legislative staff, education service centers, and members of the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to submit public comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Direct public comments on commissioner rules to the TEA Rulemaking Unit, Texas Education Agency, 1701 North Congress Avenue, Austin, Texas 78701, (512) 475-1497, or electronically to rules@tea.texas.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comments are forwarded to appropriate agency staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: 30-day public comment period
rubrics_metrics.description: Begin and end dates for the 30-day public comment period for each proposed commissioner rule action are stated in the item for the rule action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stakeholders should consult the specific rule item to determine the exact start and end dates of the 30-day comment window.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for public hearing — timing and recipient
rubrics_metrics.description: Direct requests for a public hearing on commissioner rules to the Commissioner of Education, Texas Education Agency, 1701 North Congress Avenue, Austin, Texas 78701.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Under the Administrative Procedure Act, the commissioner must receive all requests for a public hearing on a proposed rule action not more than 14 calendar days after publication of the notice of the proposal in the Texas Register.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public hearing scheduling and announcement
rubrics_metrics.description: The commissioner or the commissioner's representative will hold a public hearing on a commissioner rule at a time and place to be announced on the Secretary of State website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The TEA Rulemaking Unit sends an email to the 'Rules' mailing list announcing public hearings on commissioner rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact for questions, review, and petitions
rubrics_metrics.description: For questions about proposing, adopting, or publishing Texas Administrative Code rules; reviewing existing rules; or petitioning for rule changes, email the Rulemaking Division at rules@tea.texas.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mailing address: Texas Education Agency, 1701 N. Congress Avenue, Austin, Texas, 78701. Phone: (512) 463-9734.
